summary: Phases 1-3 complete and verified: shared scan core instrumented (default-off), scan_runner.py CLI and run-oracle-exhaustive-scan.sh created and smoke-tested, run-oracle-suite.sh deselects slow on both passes with bounded timeouts. Measured green run 649s+318s (~16min, was ~76.7min); deliberate timeout confirmed classified TIMED OUT with no orphaned workers. Phase 4 (baseline re-derivation, ~60-90min unattended serial scan) now in progress.
decisions_made: D1/D2/D3 as planned. ORACLE_SCAN_OUT_DIR env var wires test_complexity_5_scan_self_consistent's artifact_dir so the exhaustive script drives pytest directly per D2, without changing default (unset) behaviour.
test_report_writes_to_file relocated to new TestComplexity3ScanReportWriting (gating pass), within Phase 3's declared TestFullScanReport-class-body territory.
dead_ends: Manually overriding -m via run-oracle-suite.sh's trailing "$@" (e.g. -m "not slow") collapses with the script's own -m flag (last wins), corrupting the xdist_serial partition and causing contention-induced OracleTimeoutError test failures unrelated to real regressions -- do not use this as a verification method once Phase 3's fixed -m expressions are in place.
